Program Manager · Strategic Partnerships · Youth Leadership & Entrepreneurship — Bhaktapur, Nepal

Building connections. Creating opportunities. Driving meaningful impact.

Youth engagement and stakeholder-partnership professional with 5+ years building relationships with youth, colleges, NGOs and institutional partners across Nepal. Direct training and cultivation of 5,000+ youth across 10+ districts.

Who is Chandra Bhakta Adhikari?

Chandra Bhakta Adhikari (also written Chandra Adhikari, Bhakta Adhikari or C.B. Adhikari) is a Program Manager and Strategic Partnerships professional based in Bhaktapur, Kathmandu Valley, Nepal. He leads national youth-entrepreneurship programs at Nepal Business Institute (NBI), the organizer of the Nepal Business Summit and the Nepal Youth Entrepreneurship Summit (NYES). He served as District Secretary of Rotaract District 3292 (Nepal & Bhutan) in 2025–26, and has trained 5,000+ youth, educators and community members in Menstrual Hygiene Management (MHM), WASH and Disaster Risk Reduction. A geologist by training (B.Sc., Tribhuvan University), he brings field discipline to program management, stakeholder reporting and event delivery.

Also written as: Chandra Adhikari, Bhakta Adhikari, Chandra Bhakta, Chandra B. Adhikari, C. B. Adhikari, C.B. Adhikari, C B Adhikari, Chandra B Adhikari

Journey highlights

  • Trainer (Consultant), Connection Nepal (2019 to Present). You can't teach disaster preparedness from a slide deck, and you can't teach menstrual hygiene to a room that doesn't trust you yet. I learned that in my very first sessions as a Trainer with Connection Nepal, and it shaped everything about how I've approached this role since. Designing a national training program is the easy part — the real work is standing in front of a classroom of skeptical teenagers, or a circle of community elders, and earning enough trust in one session that they'll actually change a behavior after you leave.
  • District Secretary, Rotaract District 3292 (2025 to 2026). Today, at the district level, I lead administration, communications, and strategic planning for more than 150 Rotaract clubs spanning two countries — Nepal and Bhutan. Every committee, every project, every district initiative is aligned to Rotary's Areas of Focus and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, so that grassroots service work connects to something larger than any single club.
  • Program Manager, Nepal Business Institute (Sep 2025 to Present). This is the role every earlier one was quietly building toward. As Program Manager, I lead the planning and execution of Nepal's flagship business and entrepreneurship summits — owning strategy, sponsorship, government liaison, budgeting, and the complete participant journey from the first outreach message to post-event follow-up, months later.
